items.title: fix(security): block HOMEBREW_CURL_PATH and HOMEBREW_GIT_PATH from wo…
items.summary: fix(security): block HOMEBREW_CURL_PATH and HOMEBREW_GIT_PATH from workspace .env (#146389) Untrusted workspace .env files could set HOMEBREW_CURL_PATH or HOMEBREW_GIT_PATH, which Homebrew honors on Linux to select the curl and git executables it runs during brew invocations, including relative paths inside the repository. A malicious repo could therefore execute attacker-controlled binaries when a user approved a skill dependency install. Adds both keys to BLOCKED_WORKSPACE_DOTENV_KEYS, mirroring the existing HOMEBREW_BREW_FILE/HOMEBREW_PREFIX blocks (CVE-2026-53819 pattern). Trusted launching-shell and global environment values remain supported. Tracking: https://github.com/NVIDIA-dev/openclaw-tracking/issues/1049 Advisory: https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/security/advisories/GHSA-x22j-25fh-j655 Co-authored-by: eleqtrizit
